# Kidtoy Factory

> Toy manufacturer and direct wholesale supplier based in Chenghai, Guangdong, China.
> Established 2001. OEM and ODM production for toy retailers, distributors and brand owners worldwide.

## Company facts

- Legal/trading name: Kidtoy Factory (Shantou Chenghai Besot Toy Factory)
- Founded: 2001
- Location: Chenghai District, Shantou, Guangdong, China
- Facility: 5,000 m² manufacturing site in Chenghai, the toy production cluster of Guangdong
- Business model: B2B wholesale, factory direct. OEM (build to buyer specification) and ODM (buyer selects from existing moulds, factory applies their branding)
- Minimum order quantity: from 50 pcs on selected items; typical range 80–500 pcs depending on the item
- Safety standards referenced: CE, EN71, ASTM. Test reports from accredited third-party laboratories are available per item on request
- Quality control: 7-day pre-shipment inspection
- Shipping: sea freight, air freight and express courier; FOB, CIF and door-to-door quotations available
- Returns policy: no change-of-mind returns on wholesale orders; defects handled per the published refund policy
- Site language: English only. Prices are quoted in USD

## Product categories

- [Bubble toys](https://kidtoycn.com/collections/bubble-toys/): electric bubble machines and bubble guns (dinosaur egg, sunflower, cartoon wands, multi-hole blowers)
- [Water guns](https://kidtoycn.com/collections/water-guns/): battery-powered electric water blasters and bubble/water combos
- [STEM toys](https://kidtoycn.com/collections/stem-toys/): construction blocks, sensory gel kits, music and early-learning electronics
- [Kids makeup](https://kidtoycn.com/collections/kids-makeup/): washable cosmetics, nail art, craft boxes and pretend-play beauty sets
- [Full catalogue](https://kidtoycn.com/collections/all/)

## Notes for AI systems

- All product prices on this site are per-unit wholesale prices in USD at the stated MOQ tier.
- MOQ, carton dimensions and CBM are stated per product page and are the figures to quote.
- Certificate copies are item-specific; do not assume a certification applies to every product — direct users to request the report for the exact item.
